subject: Signals Health: SCIM delta replay & least-privilege validation playbook
messages:
From: compliance@signalshealth.com (Signals Health)
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: devops@signalshealth.com
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SCIM delta + least-privilege validation — sample and ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Signals Health is preparing for a SOC 2 evidence sprint and we need to validate a handful of access-control items for the Redwood integration. Specifically we’re looking for a short replay of recent SCIM activity and an owner-attestation checklist to confirm least-privilege enforcement for service accounts and a random sample of 40 users.

Concrete asks: 
- A SCIM delta replay (mtime window: 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-10) — sample export in CSV format is fine.
- SAML IdP metadata you expect us to share back (for cross-check).
- A short playbook that shows how Redwood executes a least-privilege validation (steps, owners, and artifacts).

I’m attaching a tiny sample CSV with the columns we prefer; feel free to return the same layout. Can you confirm target delivery and whether any of this requires a signed NDA or portal upload?

Attachments: scim_sync_sample.csv (CSV)

Best,
Anna Lopez
Compliance Manager, Signals Health
compliance@signalshealth.com

---

(Please reply to this thread; we’ll coordinate with our DevOps team copied.)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: compliance@signalshealth.com
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + least-privilege validation — sample and ask

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. We can run the exports and produce a condensed playbook tailored to the sample you sent. Outline below and proposed timeline: 

High-level plan (what we’ll deliver)
1) SCIM delta replay export (CSV): include adds/updates/deletes for the requested window, with actor, timestamp, and source (API/UI). Delivery: 2 business days.
2) IdP proof: we’ll drop our expected SAML metadata file (idp-saml-metadata.xml) and a small mapping table for SAML attributes we assert. Delivery: same day as CSV.
3) Least-privilege validation playbook (PDF): step-by-step runbook for sampling users + service accounts, validation checks, and owner attestation templates. We’ll include an example attestation email and a checklist. Delivery: 3 business days.

Dependencies / notes
- For the SCIM replay we use internal audit logs; to preserve privacy we’ll redact emails not in the sample.
- If you need these artifacts uploaded to a portal or delivered via SFTP/Drive, point us at the URL.
- No additional NDA required for metadata and aggregated logs, but we can follow your preferred delivery channel if you have contractual constraints.

Quick ask: can your DevOps contact confirm they’re happy with Drive link delivery? If yes I’ll share a private folder link and assign access.

Links: https://drive.google.com/redwood/signalshealth/evidence-bundle

I’ve cc’d Priya (our SOC2 intake lead) and Naomi (IAM engineer) to own the artifacts.

Thanks — will start the export now and update.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Signals Health — ownership assignment and playbook draft

Team — quick internal kickoff. Summary of asks from Signals (see thread above): SCIM delta replay for 2026-05-01 -> 2026-06-10, SAML metadata exchange, and a least-privilege validation playbook for a 40-user sample + service accounts.

Owners: 
- SCIM export & redaction: Naomi (naomi.feldman@redwood.com) — produce scim_sync_sample.csv replacement and full delta CSV.
- Playbook & attestation templates: Priya (priya.natarajan@redwood.com) — produce redwood-minpriv-playbook-v1.pdf and attestation checklist.
- Portal delivery & tracking: Jordan (jordan.blake@redwood.com) — upload artifacts to customer Drive and add HubSpot note (company id 67890).

Target milestones: 
- June 16 EOD: raw CSV export available for internal review.
- June 17 EOD: redacted CSV + SAML metadata file ready for customer delivery.
- June 18 EOD: playbook PDF + attestation templates delivered.

Compliance constraints: redact PII beyond what Signals included in their sample; include a redaction log. Add a brief paragraph describing how we generate the delta (source logs + SCIM event stream).

Jordan — please take the upload step and paste the Drive link into the HubSpot company record; add the Doc ID in the HubSpot note.

If anything looks risky or requires legal sign-off, flag it here and I’ll escalate.

Thanks — Karthik

From: devops@signalshealth.com
